artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Portal branch wk-AMGT_CORPUS-46-2-portal, LOCAL, not pushed. buildModelSheet with a served team_sheet carrying row_classes builds the team rows in sheet order: CONTROL counted only; HEADING as rowKind heading with no cells; FIGURE Bloomberg-first (label match with a served figure), then the team's own finite values verbatim per sheet year with teamCite, then a why in words. teamCensus over the sheet rows. Without row_classes the output is byte-equal to the base (AC1 control).

Heading lines with data-model-row-kind heading; team rows carry a visible team model label and the cite in a title; team values print as saved; why rows say their absentReason on the row and are kept out of the absent footnote. The master_absent one-line reason is unchanged.
team_sheet gains optional row_classes, row_numbers, row_values and periods, so an old payload still type-checks (bun run typecheck rc 0 on the committed tree; mutant rc 2).
